data.narrative:
Blue Energy, a Growth-stage nuclear energy company founded by Jake Jurewicz, has raised $380M to date. The valuation universe consists of 11 comparable companies across nuclear energy: 3 public (OKLO, NNE, SMR) and 8 private peers including Helion, Oklo, Valar Atomics, X-Energy, and Nano Nuclear Energy.

A single triangulation method proved applicable to this analysis. Stage-Progression methodology, anchoring to the $380M total raised as a valuation proxy and applying a 1.2x step-up multiplier typical of Growth-stage advancement, yields an implied valuation of $456M. A peer-median approach was not feasible due to insufficient same-stage and adjacent-stage comparables within the nuclear energy sector; while 6 same-sector peers exist, none satisfied narrow filtering criteria for stage and valuation tier alignment, making sector-wide medians unreliably broad.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $388M (low) to $524M (high), with a median point of $456M. The narrow methodological foundation—relying on a single applicable technique—represents the primary uncertainty. Refinement would benefit from either closer same-stage peer valuation data or operational metrics (MW capacity, development milestones, burn rate) to anchor alternative DCF or comparable revenue multiples approaches. Stage-progression multipliers remain sensitive to near-term funding and technical de-risking outcomes.
